124        public PerseanLeagueMembership(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
125                this.faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.PERSEAN);
126                
127                setImportant(true);
128                setLeagueMember(true);
129                new EstablishedPolityScript();
130                
131                Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().setSecondaryColorOverride(getFaction().getBaseUIColor());
132                Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().setSecondaryColorSegmentsOverride(8);
133                
134                TextPanelAPI text = null;
135                if (dialog != null) text = dialog.getTextPanel();
136                
137                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
138                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
139                
140                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this, true);
141                
142                RepLevel level = faction.getRelToPlayer().getLevel();
143                if (!level.isAtWorst(RepLevel.NEUTRAL)) {
144                        Misc.adjustRep(Factions.PERSEAN, 2f, RepLevel.NEUTRAL, text);
145                }
146                
147                sendUpdate(UPDATE_PARAM_ACCEPTED, text);
148        }

158                
159                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(KEY);
160                
161                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
162        }

193        public String getName() {
194                String postfix = "";
195                if (isEnding() && endType != null) {
196                        switch (endType) {
197                        case BROKEN:
198                                postfix = " - " + getBrokenPostfix();
199                                break;
200                        case ENDED:
201                                postfix = " - " + getEndedPostfix();
202                                break;
203                        case EXPIRED:
204                                postfix = " - " + getExpiredPostfix();
205                                break;
206                        }
207                }
208                if (isSendingUpdate() && getListInfoParam() == UPDATE_PARAM_ACCEPTED) {
209                        postfix =  " - " + getAcceptedPostfix();
210                }
211                return getBaseName() + postfix;
212        }

223        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
224                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
225                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
226                float pad = 3f;
227                float opad = 10f;
228                
229                float initPad = pad;
230                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
231                
232                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
233                
234                bullet(info);
235                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
236                
237//              if (getListInfoParam() == UPDATE_PARAM_ACCEPTED) {
238//                      return;
239//              }
240
241                int perMonth = computeCreditsPerMonth();
242                if (perMonth != 0 && !isEnded() && !isEnding()) {
243                        Color c = perMonth > 0 ? h : Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
244                        info.addPara("%s per month", initPad, tc, c, Misc.getDGSCredits(perMonth));
245                }
246        
247                unindent(info);
248        }

263        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
264                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
265                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
266                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
267                float pad = 3f;
268                float opad = 10f;
269
270                Color c = faction.getBaseUIColor();
271                
272                info.addImage(getFaction().getLogo(), width, 128, opad);
273                
274                if (isEnding() || isEnded()) {
275                        info.addPara("Your agreement with the League is no longer in force.", opad, c, "League");
276                        return;
277                }
278                
279                if (isGoodDeal()) {
280                        info.addPara("You've negotiated a good membership deal from a position of strength. "
281                                        + "The League will support you politically, which "
282                                        + "for example makes it untenable for the Hegemony to insist on AI inspections "
283                                        + "in your space.", opad, c, "League");
284                        
285                        if (isPayingHouseHannan()) {
286                                info.addPara("Part of your arrangement involves unofficial payments directly to the accounts "
287                                                + "of House Hannan, as payment for facilitating this agreement.", opad);
288                                addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
289                                ButtonAPI button = info.addButton("Renege on the payments", BUTTON_RENEGE_HANNAN, 
290                                                getFactionForUIColors().getBaseUIColor(), getFactionForUIColors().getDarkUIColor(),
291                                                (int)(width), 20f, opad * 1f);
292                                button.setShortcut(Keyboard.KEY_G, true);
293                                info.addSpacer(opad);
294                        }
295                } else {
296                        info.addPara("You've joined the Persean League, though it's whispered that you only did so to avoid "
297                                        + "harassment, and your membership dues are nothing more than protection payments. "
298                                        + "However, the League still supports you politically, which "
299                                        + "for example makes it untenable for the Hegemony to insist on AI inspections "
300                                        + "in your space.", opad, c, "Persean League");
301                }
302                
303                info.addPara("Due to being new members of the League, your colonies enjoy an "
304                                + "increased flow of trade, resulting in a %s accessibility bonus.",
305                                opad, h,
306                                "+" + (int)Math.round(EstablishedPolity.ACCESSIBILITY_BONUS * 100f) + "%");
307                
308                info.addPara("Your League membership is contingent on maintaining an active Persean League commission. If "
309                                + "you resign it, or if it is annulled for any reason, your membership will end as well.", opad);
310                
311                if (computeCreditsPerMonth() != 0 && !isPayingHouseHannan()) {
312                        info.addPara("You are paying membership dues to the League.", opad);
313                        addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
314                }
315                
316                        
317                ButtonAPI button = info.addButton("End League membership", BUTTON_END, 
318                                getFactionForUIColors().getBaseUIColor(), getFactionForUIColors().getDarkUIColor(),
319                                (int)(width), 20f, opad * 1f);
320                button.setShortcut(Keyboard.KEY_U, true);
321                
322        }

351        public void reportEconomyTick(int iterIndex) {
352                
353                int credits = computeCreditsPerTick();
354
355                if (credits != 0) {
356                        FDNode node = getMonthlyReportNode();
357                        if (credits > 0) {
358                                node.income += credits;
359                        } else if (credits < 0) {
360                                node.upkeep -= credits;
361                        }
362                }
363        }
364        
365        public FDNode getMonthlyReportNode() {
366                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
367                FDNode marketsNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS);
368                if (marketsNode.name == null) {
369                        marketsNode.name = "Colonies";
370                        marketsNode.custom = MonthlyReport.OUTPOSTS;
371                        marketsNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
372                }
373                
374                FDNode paymentNode = report.getNode(marketsNode, "persean_league_membership"); 
375                paymentNode.name = "Persean League membership dues";
376                //paymentNode.upkeep += payment;
377                //paymentNode.icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("income_report", "generic_expense");
378                paymentNode.icon = faction.getCrest();
379                
380                if (paymentNode.tooltipCreator == null) {
381                        paymentNode.tooltipCreator = new TooltipCreator() {
382                                public boolean isTooltipExpandable(Object tooltipParam) {
383                                        return false;
384                                }
385                                public float getTooltipWidth(Object tooltipParam) {
386                                        return 450;
387                                }
388                                public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
389                                        tooltip.addPara("Monthly dues for keeping your Persean League membership in good standing.", 0f);
390                                }
391                        };
392                }
393                
394                return paymentNode;
395        }
396
397        public int computeCreditsPerMonth() {
398                int perTick = computeCreditsPerTick();
399                float numIter = Global.getSettings().getFloat("economyIterPerMonth");
400                return (int) (perTick * numIter);
401        }
402        
403        public static int computeCreditsPerTick() {
404                float numIter = Global.getSettings().getFloat("economyIterPerMonth");
405                float f = 1f / numIter;
406                
407                int payment = 0;
408                float feeFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("perseanLeagueFeeFraction");
409                if (isGoodDeal()) {
410                        feeFraction = 0f;
411                }
412                if (isPayingHouseHannan()) {
413                        feeFraction += Global.getSettings().getFloat("houseHannanFeeFraction");
414                }
415                
416                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getPlayerMarkets(false)) {
417                        payment += (int) (market.getGrossIncome() * f) * feeFraction;
418                }
419                
420                return -payment;
421        }

427        public void endMembership(AgreementEndingType type, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
428                if (!isEnded() && !isEnding()) {
429                        boolean baseMembership = !PerseanLeagueMembership.isGoodDeal();
430                        
431                        endType = type;
432                        setImportant(false);
433                        //endAfterDelay();
434                        endImmediately();
435                        
436                        incrLeftLeagueCount();
437                        
438                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().setSecondaryColorOverride(null);
439                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().setSecondaryColorSegmentsOverride(0);
440                        
441                        if (dialog != null) {
442                                sendUpdate(new Object(), dialog.getTextPanel());
443                        }
444                        
445                        if (baseMembership) {
446                                HA_CMD.sendPerseanLeaguePunitiveExpedition(dialog);
447                        }
448                        
449                }
450        }

453        public static void stopPayingHouseHannan(boolean trustBroken, boolean noReynardRepLoss, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
454                if (isPayingHouseHannan()) {
455                        TextPanelAPI text = null;
456                        if (dialog != null) text = dialog.getTextPanel();
457                        PersonAPI reynard = People.getPerson(People.REYNARD_HANNAN);
458                        
459                        // only make Reynard mad if it's the "trustBroken" case.
460                        // other uses imply a level of politicking where he has to pretend to be fine with stopping payment. -dgb 
461                        if (reynard != null && !noReynardRepLoss) {
462                                Misc.adjustRep(reynard, -0.5f, text);
463                                ContactIntel.removeContact(reynard, dialog);
464                        }
465                        setPayingHouseHannan(false);
466                        
467                        new GensHannanMachinations(dialog);
468                        if (trustBroken) {
469                                Misc.incrUntrustwortyCount();
470                        }
471                }
472        }

474        @Override
475        public void buttonPressConfirmed(Object buttonId, IntelUIAPI ui) {
476                if (buttonId == BUTTON_END) {
477                        endMembership(AgreementEndingType.ENDED, null);
478                } else if (buttonId == BUTTON_RENEGE_HANNAN) {
479                        stopPayingHouseHannan(true, false, null);
480                }
481                super.buttonPressConfirmed(buttonId, ui);
482        }

485        @Override
486        public void createConfirmationPrompt(Object buttonId, TooltipMakerAPI prompt) {
487                FactionAPI faction = getFactionForUIColors();
488                
489                if (buttonId == BUTTON_END) {
490                        if (isGoodDeal()) {
491                                String extra = "";
492                                LabelAPI label = prompt.addPara("You've negotiated a good membership deal from a position of strength. If "
493                                                + "you leave, you will not be allowed to rejoin, but the " +
494                                                faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + " will likely refrain "
495                                                + "from harassing your interests." + extra, 0f,
496                                                Misc.getTextColor(), faction.getBaseUIColor(), 
497                                                faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
498                                        label.setHighlightColors(Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), faction.getBaseUIColor());
499                                        label.setHighlight("will not be allowed to rejoin", faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
500                                if (isPayingHouseHannan()) {
501                                        prompt.addPara("However, Gens Hannan will not be pleased with their payments being stopped.",
502                                                        10f, Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), "Gens Hannan will not be pleased");
503                                }
504                        } else {
505                                String extra = "";
506                                boolean canRejoin = getNumTimesLeftLeague() < TIMES_LEFT_LEAGUE_FOR_NO_REJOIN - 1;
507                                float rejoinPad = 10f;
508                                if (HA_CMD.canSendPerseanLeaguePunitiveExpedition()) {
509                                        LabelAPI label = prompt.addPara(
510                                                        "If you leave, " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + " will likely take"
511                                                        + " drastic action against your colonies." + extra, 0f);
512                                        label.setHighlightColors(faction.getBaseUIColor(), Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
513                                        label.setHighlight(faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle(), "drastic action");
514                                } else {
515                                        if (canRejoin) {
516                                                prompt.addPara("If you leave, " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + " will likely start "
517                                                                + " harassing your interests in the near future.", 0f,
518                                                                Misc.getTextColor(), faction.getBaseUIColor(), 
519                                                                faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
520                                        } else {
521                                                rejoinPad = 0f;
522                                        }
523                                }
524                                if (!canRejoin) {
525                                        prompt.addPara("Given your history, it is likely that you would not be allowed "
526                                                        + "to rejoin the League at any point in the future.",
527                                                        rejoinPad, Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), 
528                                                        "would not be allowed to rejoin");
529                                }
530                        }
531                } else if (buttonId == BUTTON_RENEGE_HANNAN) {
532                        prompt.addPara("Gens Hannan will not be pleased. While they are unlikely to be unable to obtain your outright "
533                                        + "explulsion from the League, their influence is significant and will likely be used "
534                                        + "to continually undermine your standing. ", 0f, 
535                                        Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), 
536                                        "continually undermine your standing");
537                        
538                        prompt.addPara("You will also lose Reynard Hannan as a contact.", 10f, 
539                                        Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), 
540                                        "lose Reynard Hannan");
541                }
542        }
